title: VALORANT Masters Toronto
description: A cinematic esports promo exploring reflection, redemption and the pursuit of the Masters trophy.
overview: A suspended trophy, fractured reflections and characters caught in motion set the scene for VALORANT Masters Toronto. The film moves through a surreal space where moments of stillness give way to bursts of action.

Cool greens and violet light connect the character shots to the trophy, before the sequence resolves into “Reflection // Redemption” and the event identity. These selected frames capture the atmosphere and visual contrasts of the piece.
